newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine cash wheat up in tight trade.
newsitem.headline: Argentine cash wheat up in tight trade.

text.p: Argentine wheat firmed in tight cash market trade at Buenos Aires Cereals Exchange, as bids were squeezed by a stubborn lack of supply, traders said.
With exporters pressured by quality problems with some of the forward-purchased wheat now being delivered, suppliers are holding out for higher prices.

March wheat rose $1 to $141. Cash maize and soybeans rose in the slipstream of a higher Chicago, with volumes low. April maize gained $2 to $98, while May soybeans jumped $5 to $247. March sunflower seed was dragged upwards after soybeans, rising $3 to $212 in slim turnover.
